summary: Företag 19 is a Swedish AI company developing biologically inspired artificial intelligence systems designed to learn and adapt autonomously. The company focuses on machine intelligence based on principles derived from natural nervous systems.
strategy_notes: Focused on commercializing biologically inspired AI technologies capable of autonomous learning and adaptation.
technology_notes: Develops AI architectures inspired by natural intelligence and nervous system principles rather than conventional data-intensive approaches.
risk_notes: Dependent on successful commercialization, technical validation, funding availability and adoption in a highly competitive AI market.
